goal.decided: The user gets from rn each deliverable they mean, every one meeting each necessary condition of its best practice, and answers only what's theirs.

A reader takes in a reworked document as its writer meant, reading once from the top

Each part a developer builds by the design gives, with the others, what the README promises
A maker of code designs it, tests it first, and writes it as the field's established practice says

Lane's developers see, before anyone builds a part, whether Lane's parts joined as its architecture draws give each key result

rn's developers see, before anyone builds a part, whether rn's parts joined as its architecture draws give each key result

decisions.about: Which case of rn's rules waits for the generator's prompt
decisions.decided: test_a_command_run_by_itself_is_stopped, as the guard stops a command the generator runs by itself only by a run_only Lane of the step that tries commands, which /lane:up lays from the generator's steps; its NO_RUN_ONLY mark goes once rn holds that Lane laid

decisions.about: Which hook holds each step and each practice of rn's roles
How the generator's unit case checks the walkthrough's deliverable, whose decision names mypy --strict, which no environment of the repository holds

deliverables.name: An evaluator judges a deliverable as its people meet it, and answers each necessary condition of its group good or more in its people's words
rn gives the deliverable a person means at the size of a real request, as the product vision's key results show

decisions.decided: the README's walkthrough, type hints for a library the size of invoicer in lovaizu/playground, so that the E2E test runs what the README shows its readers

decisions.about: A comparison with Claude Code alone
decisions.decided: none: the E2E test shows KR1.1 and KR1.2 alone, as rn's worth is that once the user has answered what's theirs, a deliverable that meets their purpose comes without them, which a request this small, where Claude Code alone wins plainly, can't show, nor the two deliverables' quality side by side

deliverables.name: Users install Lane and rn together from one pull request, each plugin's folder holding all it needs and its README's walkthrough taken from what its tests show
deliverables.check: claude plugin validate passes on each plugin's folder, Lane's README walkthrough is what its integration cases show word for word, rn's is its E2E test's recorded run, and one pull request holds both plugins

decisions.decided: each plugin's folder holds everything it needs and its own copy of the repository's LICENSE, links any page outside it by its URL on GitHub, and sets homepage and repository in plugin.json; rn uses Lane through dependencies, and Lane uses no other plugin
Lane releases together with rn, in one pull request, once rn is done

decisions.about: The README after the E2E test
decisions.decided: the README's walkthrough takes the E2E test's recorded run, and its install steps are mended where the E2E test's install fell short, as the README was made before the product existed

deliverables.name: ccpm's guide to building a Claude Code plugin says what each plugin takes from it, as its architecture names
deliverables.check: the plugin guide and dev/plugin-template say what each plugin takes from them, and rn and Lane follow them

decisions.about: Where the steps of a typed command lie
decisions.decided: each command the person types has its SKILL.md hold the steps of that moment, as Claude Code loads it when typed, and the orchestrator holds only the steps that every moment shares, as a controller and its domain logic

decisions.about: Each step and each practice carried out
decisions.decided: each role, the main conversation's skill among them, records each step of its prompt and each practice of the best practice it works by, at the time each names, and its end, or the skill's turn's end where it puts work up, passes only where the plugin's own check accepts the record, as the guard runs that check
a prompt is a part: unit tests run it on the model its users run, several times, and E2E tests try it in real use

an evaluator answers each question good, with the lines that meet it, or what would make it good, in the plugin guide's words good, more, and good_when, and the plugin template, rn, and Lane use those words wherever they carry an evaluator's answer, as the guide is the one source and met, not met, and lacks say the same thing with other words

decisions.about: Where a plugin writes its files, and the deliverables it makes
decisions.decided: the guide's rule of where a plugin writes covers the files of the plugin's own run; a deliverable that a run makes for the user lies where the repository's layout or the tool that reads it puts it, such as a best practice rn makes at .rn/best-practices/<kind>/, as the design tree best practice decides a deliverable's path

decisions.about: When the guard runs the record check on the main conversation
decisions.decided: the guard runs the plugin's own record check at a role's end and at each end of the main conversation's turn in a run, and the check passes a turn that puts no work up for the caller, such as one that asks a question, as Lane serves any plugin and can't tell which turn puts work up, which only the plugin knows

decisions.about: How a prompt's unit tests judge
decisions.decided: each case runs as many times as Test strategy sets, each run a test of its own, and the developer judges the prompt from the results, with no criterion, as a criterion over runs that vary passes or fails by chance
